stage1.impression: A moody, believable dusk vignette: the plaster wall and its glow are the most photographic thing here, and the horn-shaped shade makes a strong, simple silhouette. But the whole frame is drowned in one magenta cast so the wall, wood and acrylic all read as the same plum, the opal sleeve shows as three hot bulb-blobs, the foot sinks to near black, and a cropped, crushed blue mass of loudspeaker fills the left fifth like a mistake rather than context. It reads as a good CG still, not yet a campaign page.

blocking_9: Neutral-to-warm wall near the lamp (cream, not pink) with a cool dusk falloff away from it, so the tinted shade is the only magenta thing in frame
Opal sleeve reads as one soft glowing cylinder with no discrete hot spots and no more than about 3% clipped pixels
The lamp's foot reads as tinted acrylic with visible colour and an edge highlight, not a black disc
A visible, warm pool of the lamp's own light on the cabinet top under the shade, brighter than the wall below the shade
The loudspeaker either reads as a legible, intentional silhouette in soft focus or leaves the frame; no cropped, crushed blue block at the edge
Some depth beyond a flat wall 0.7 m behind the lamp (room corner, window light, or receding space) so the frame has foreground, subject and background
No dead black band at the bottom: the cabinet front holds texture

defects.what: Global magenta cast: a #EEE9E1 wall measures RGB 83/45/72 at right, 183/127/142 in the halo; green channel suppressed everywhere
Opal sleeve 21% clipped, with two bright round blobs either side reading as point bulbs, not a diffuse opal
Loudspeaker cropped by the frame edge, 27% crushed, saturated blue reflections (B 132 vs R 18); its form is illegible and it competes with the lamp
Foot crushed: median luminance 8, G 1; the tinted discs read black, colour lost
Cabinet top dark and red (median 31, R68 G21 B32); no clear light pool from the shade on it, top beside the foot at 39 vs wall below the shade at 84
Cabinet front 48% crushed: a dead black band across the bottom of the frame
Shade body lit unevenly with a bright reflected disc of the sleeve inside the mouth (around 920-1010, 535-555) that reads as a second light source
Flat staging: wall parallel to sensor directly behind the lamp, no depth or window light in frame; slight overall softness from denoising

changes.problem: The lilac fill and the colour pipeline turn the cream wall magenta, so the shade's tint has nothing neutral to read against.

evidence.measured: RGB median 83/45/72 against specified #EEE9E1, delta E2000 65; halo 183/127/142

change.to: #9FB2D6 (cool dusk blue, as if from the window)

changes.expected: Wall away from the lamp drifts cool blue-grey, wall near the lamp warm cream; magenta only in the acrylic. Right wall G median rises to at least 0.8 of R.

changes.problem: White balance at 3100 K against 2700 K sources plus the tint leaves a magenta-pink halo instead of warm white lamplight.

evidence.measured: halo R183 G127 B142: B above G means magenta, not warm

change.to: 3400, with green tint +6 if the pipeline allows it

changes.expected: Halo reads warm cream (R > G > B), not pink.

changes.problem: Three small point lamps show through the opal as discrete hot bulbs and clip a fifth of the sleeve.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 21.0, p95 245; two round blobs visible at the sleeve's left and right

change.to: radius 0.04 m each (or one cylinder emitter filling the sleeve), led strength 6

changes.expected: Sleeve reads as one even opal glow with soft gradation; clip under 3%.

changes.problem: The loudspeaker is cropped at the frame edge, crushed and blue, and reads as an unidentifiable dark block that competes with the hero.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 27, B median 56 vs R 6, form illegible

change.to: [-0.85, 1.1, 0] (further back and left so it falls into soft focus as a whole silhouette), and add a dim warm rim from a 2700 K point lamp of 3 W at [-0.3, 1.3, 1.3]

changes.expected: Speaker reads as a soft, recognisable horn silhouette in the same tint behind the lamp's plane, no saturated blue block; left fifth crush under 12%.

changes.problem: The foot of tinted discs goes black, losing the product's colour where it meets the furniture.

change.to: area 0.4 x 0.2 m, 2700 K, 4 W, at [0.9, -0.3, 0.75] aimed at [0.36, 0.38, 0.7], grazing the foot's front edge from camera right

changes.expected: Foot shows violet body colour and a thin edge highlight; median above 25, crush under 8%.

changes.problem: The cabinet top is too dark and red to catch the lamp's downlight, so the lamp seems not to light what it stands on.

evidence.measured: lum_median 39 (R81 G29 B29) vs wall below shade 84

change.to: lighter natural oak (base around #B08A60), roughness 0.45, or a pale stone top

changes.expected: A warm pool of light on the top under and beside the shade, brighter than the wall below it.

changes.problem: Flat-on staging against a wall 0.7 m behind gives no depth and spends the bottom fifth on a black cabinet front.

change.to: [0.95, -1.1, 1.0] -> [0.3, 0.45, 1.0], 50 mm, f/2.8, so the wall recedes at an angle toward a lit room corner and the frame bottom sits at the cabinet top edge

changes.expected: Wall falls off with distance, lamp against a gradient, cabinet front mostly out of frame; more room for type at top right.

changes.problem: There is no dusk in the frame: the window is out of view, so 'the room at dusk' is asserted only by colour.

evidence.measured: no sky or window visible; all ambient arrives as a uniform magenta-blue

change.from: window on the left wall, out of frame; sky gradient strength 6
change.to: let a sliver of the window or its cool light patch fall on the back wall at far left (sky strength 8, horizon #6C82A8), giving a cool-versus-warm split across the frame

changes.expected: A cool blue light on the left of the wall against the lamp's warm pool on the right; reads as dusk.

out_of_scope.request: The bright reflected disc of the sleeve on the stem collar inside the shade's mouth reads as a second light
out_of_scope.why: It comes from the product's own stem and collar geometry; only lighting can soften it, not a change to the part
